classification.difficultyReason: Identify the bracket as the hypotenuse, apply Pythagoras and round centimetres to the nearest millimetre.

content.prompt: A support bracket is to be placed under a shelf, as shown in the diagram. If $AB=AC=20\text{ cm}$, find, correct to the nearest millimetre, the length of $BC$.

spec.description: Shelf extends beyond B; wall extends above A and below C; bracket joins C to B, with a right angle at A.
spec.mathematics: AB and AC are perpendicular and both equal 20 cm. BC is the hypotenuse.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}BC^2&=20^2+20^2\\BC^2&=800\\BC&=\sqrt{800}\text{ cm}\\BC&\approx28.3\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
This is $283\text{ mm}$, correct to the nearest millimetre.
